import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a comprehensive visualization with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
color_palette = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Gender
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
for i, gender in enumerate(df['Gender'].unique()):
    gender_data = df[df['Gender'] == gender]
    ax1.scatter(gender_data['Sleep Duration'], gender_data['Quality of Sleep'], 
                alpha=0.6, s=80, label=gender, color=color_palette[i])
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Gender', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend()
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Sleep Disorder Distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
sleep_disorder_counts = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None').value_counts()
colors_pie = sns.color_palette("Set2", len(sleep_disorder_counts))
ax2.pie(sleep_disorder_counts.values, labels=sleep_disorder_counts.index, 
        autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors_pie)
ax2.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Physical Activity vs Stress Level
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
scatter = ax3.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Stress Level'], 
                     c=df['Quality of Sleep'], cmap='RdYlGn', s=60, alpha=0.6)
ax3.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Stress Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Physical Activity vs Stress Level', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax3)
cbar.set_label('Sleep Quality', fontsize=10)

# 4. Average Sleep Duration by Occupation (Top 10)
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1:])
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)
bars = ax4.barh(range(len(occupation_sleep)), occupation_sleep.values, color=color_palette[3])
ax4.set_yticks(range(len(occupation_sleep)))
ax4.set_yticklabels(occupation_sleep.index, fontsize=9)
ax4.set_xlabel('Average Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Top 10 Occupations by Average Sleep Duration', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax4.invert_yaxis()
for i, v in enumerate(occupation_sleep.values):
    ax4.text(v + 0.05, i, f'{v:.2f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 5. BMI Category Distribution by Sleep Quality
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
bmi_quality = df.groupby(['BMI Category', 'Quality of Sleep']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
bmi_quality.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax5, colormap='viridis', width=0.7)
ax5.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('BMI Category by Sleep Quality Distribution', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax5.legend(title='Quality', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left', fontsize=8)
ax5.set_xticklabels(ax5.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')

# 6. Daily Steps vs Heart Rate
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
ax6.scatter(df['Daily Steps'], df['Heart Rate'], alpha=0.5, s=60, color=color_palette[5])
z = np.polyfit(df['Daily Steps'].dropna(), df['Heart Rate'].dropna(), 1)
p = np.poly1d(z)
ax6.plot(sorted(df['Daily Steps']), p(sorted(df['Daily Steps'])), 
         "r--", alpha=0.8, linewidth=2, label='Trend')
ax6.set_xlabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Daily Steps vs Heart Rate', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax6.legend()
ax6.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 7. Age Distribution by Sleep Disorder
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
sleep_disorder_filled = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
disorders = sleep_disorder_filled.unique()
for disorder in disorders:
    disorder_data = df[sleep_disorder_filled == disorder]['Age']
    ax7.hist(disorder_data, alpha=0.6, bins=15, label=disorder, edgecolor='black')
ax7.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_title('Age Distribution by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax7.legend(fontsize=8)

# Overall title
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', 
             fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
